scenario: 今天的主线是 agent 推理服务里的缓存和调度。一篇论文发现一次流量突发就能让靠前缀缓存的 agent 服务长期卡在低命中率，得在网关暂停部分会话才能恢复；ShadowPrefill 用空闲算力提前在备选模型上补算上下文，减轻按步换模型的代价。TKNP、ADIndex 和 SlackTier 分别从注意力在哪算、稀疏注意力的索引和大查找表放在哪入手，压低长上下文 decode 的开销。ForeSpark 和 NVLinkOneSided 砍掉小 batch 下投机解码和 MoE 通信的浪费。

papers.title: Bursts That Outlast Themselves: Persistent Degradation in Prefix-Cached Agent Serving
papers.abstract: LLM agents drive inference engines with closed-loop sessions whose context grows every turn, and serving them economically depends on prefix caching: a hit costs an incremental prefill of about a thousand tokens, a miss recomputes a 10--40K-token context. We show that this makes prefix-cached agent serving metastable. With an identical base workload, a few minutes of extra arrivals leaves a vLLM server in a degraded regime--a 10% hit ratio, about half the throughput, and a backlog that grows for the remaining 70 minutes--while its no-burst twin stays healthy (9 of 12 pairs; none in the reverse direction). The regime appears at loads the cache-warm server sustains, is absent without prefix caching, and also appears with Qwen3-32B on SWE-bench agent trace shapes and on SGLang, which tolerates larger triggers. Slower service keeps more sessions in the system, their working set outgrows the KV pool, and every turn becomes a recomputation; a first-order workload-balance condition, calibrated independently, brackets when the regime can drain. Getting out is the harder problem: throttling new admissions recovered 1 of 7 matched collapsed runs, while suspending admitted sessions against a capacity-based limit recovered all of them within minutes. A CPU offload tier delays the collapse but does not prevent it. A budgeter that bounds the resident KV demand of active sessions to the pool, with thresholds that need no per-workload tuning, prevented the failure in every run we tested.
papers.summary: 给 agent 做推理服务，全靠前缀缓存撑着：命中时每轮只补算新增的内容，没命中就要把几万 token 的上下文整段重算。作者发现这会让服务掉进一个出不来的坏状态。同样的基础流量，只多来几分钟突发请求，vLLM 的缓存命中率就跌到 10% 左右，吞吐减半，突发过去后积压还在涨。原因是一个循环：服务一慢，同时在线的会话变多，它们的上下文加起来超过 KV 池，每个会话的前缀在下一轮之前就被别的会话挤掉，于是每轮都重算，服务更慢。崩了以后只挡新请求，7 次里只救回 1 次；在轮次间隙暂停一部分已在跑的会话，让活跃会话的 KV 总需求不超过池子容量，每次都能在几分钟内恢复。==跑 agent 服务时，要按 KV 容量管住已经进来的会话==。

papers.title: ForeSpark: Joint Draft and Verification Budget Scheduling for Parallel Speculative Decoding
papers.authors: Jaeyong Song, Daniel Wang, Pratyush Patel, Jonny Kong, Preyas Shah, Shobhit Kanaujia
papers.abstract: Parallel drafters accelerate LLM decoding by proposing a whole block of draft tokens in a single forward pass, making them attractive for LLM serving. Recent systems optimize goodput (i.e., accepted tokens per second) because rejected drafts steal compute from other requests. However, these systems control only how many tokens are verified, so every request still drafts a full block. At high serving load, we find that drafting consumes up to 40% of step time, of which a majority is discarded because it is never verified. Yet, draft-length control from autoregressive drafters does not carry over, because a parallel drafter commits to its length before its single pass. Moreover, draft and verification lengths are coupled across the batch, so they must be selected jointly for every request while keeping the decision computationally cheap at every step. In this paper, we propose work-conserving speculation (WCS), a design that jointly allocates draft and verification budgets per request in LLM serving, and present ForeSpark as its prototype. ForeSpark realizes WCS with (i) a context-aware pre-draft estimator that predicts acceptance for every candidate length from the target model's context features, (ii) a lightweight joint draft-verify scheduler that selects both lengths through a global sort, and (iii) a post-draft budget distribution that spends verification on the most promising tokens. Implemented on vLLM, ForeSpark improves throughput by up to 1.77x over the state-of-the-art DSpark and by 2.49x over autoregressive decoding at a matched per-request generation rate, without changing the output distribution. It also tolerates higher load, sustaining up to 1.51x the request rate of DSpark under latency service level objectives (SLOs).
papers.summary: 并行草稿模型一次前向就能写出一整块草稿 token。现在的做法是先写满一整块，再挑最有希望的几个去验证。作者发现高负载下这很浪费：写草稿占到每步时间的 40%，而写出来的大部分根本没被验证就丢掉了。难点在于并行草稿模型必须在写之前就定好长度，没法像逐个生成的草稿模型那样写到没把握时停下。ForeSpark 在写草稿前，先用目标模型当前的上下文特征估计每个请求写不同长度时能被接受多少，再把整个 batch 里所有请求的草稿长度和验证名额一起排序分配。在 vLLM 上，同样的单请求生成速度下，吞吐比目前最强的 DSpark 最多高 1.77 倍，输出分布不变。==草稿写多长，要在写之前按请求定下来==。

papers.title: One-Sided Expert-Parallel All-to-All for Mixture-of-Experts Inference over NVLink
papers.authors: Bo Li, Chulian Zhang, Or Biri, Anthony Chang, Anton Korzh, Noam Duvdevani, XingFei Xi, Daniel Stokes, Zhenhuan Chen, Ludwig Schneider, Artem Y. Polyakov, Julien Demouth, Chandler Zhou
papers.abstract: Expert parallelism (EP) shards the experts of a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layer across GPUs, so every MoE layer requires two all-to-all communications, namely dispatch and combine. Compared with training, inference processes relatively few tokens per GPU at a time, and at small batch sizes fixed costs that do not grow with the number of tokens, rather than data movement, dominate the latency. We present NVLinkOneSided, a one-sided EP all-to-all for GPUs within a single NVLink domain. Each source rank pushes its tokens, without first exchanging metadata, into rank-major buffers on the target GPUs, and the grouped GEMMs read them in place instead of from a per-expert copy. We provide two protocols for the synchronization that the communication requires, namely Fence and Sentinel, for high-throughput and low-latency scenarios respectively. On Blackwell GPUs, NVLinkOneSided completes dispatch and combine 1.2-3.0× faster than DeepEP, with the largest speedups at small batch sizes. The resulting MoE layer is up to 2.4× faster than DeepEP with DeepGEMM. It even outperforms the fused DeepGEMM MegaMoE at up to 128 tokens per GPU, making it still competitive for decoding. We expose NVLinkOneSided through a modular interface, so that it is agnostic to the activation quantization format, decoupled from the MoE compute backend and easy to integrate into inference frameworks.
papers.summary: MoE 推理时每一层都要做两次 all-to-all：先把 token 发到持有对应专家的 GPU，再把专家的输出收回来。推理时每张卡一次只处理很少的 token，这时耗时的不是搬数据，而是 GPU 之间互相等待、同步这类固定开销：数据量小到在 NVLink 上几乎瞬间传完，一来一回却要几十微秒。NVLinkOneSided 让每张卡只凭自己的路由结果，直接把 token 写进目标卡上专门留给它的那块缓冲区，不用先交换 token 数量之类的信息；后面的分组 GEMM 也直接从这块缓冲区读，不再按专家重新复制一遍。在 Blackwell GPU 上，发送加回收比 DeepEP 快 1.2 到 3.0 倍，batch 越小优势越大。整层 MoE 在每卡 128 个 token 以内，比融合成一个 kernel 的 DeepGEMM MegaMoE 还快。==小 batch 的 decode 通信，要省的是固定开销，带宽反而不是瓶颈==。

papers.title: SHADOWPREFILL: Keeping Your Next Model Warm for Per-Step Model Routing in Agentic LLM Serving
papers.authors: Haoran Qiu, Rohan Mahapatra, Rodrigo Fonseca, Mark Russinovich
papers.abstract: Per-step model routers send each LLM call of an agent to the cost-optimal model dynamically within each session. However, every model switch discards prefix-cache reuse: KV caches are per model, so the new model must prefill the relevant context before it emits a token. Across representative agentic workloads, including a production coding-agent trace with a mean context of 63K tokens, the prefix hit rate falls from 80-89% on same model calls to 44-65% after a switch, and a switch call takes 1.5-3.2x as long. We present SHADOWPREFILL, which prefills the session's context on the model the router has not chosen, in capacity that instances serving normal traffic leave idle, so the next switch finds its prefix cached. SHADOWPREFILL harvests the per-iteration SLO slack of requests in flight, protects routed calls, spills shadow KV to host memory, and falls back to a cold switch whenever the shadow is incomplete. With LLMRouter routing 24 model pairs over five agentic benchmark suites, SHADOWPREFILL cuts switch-call latency by 8.5-21.4%, LLM-call latency by 3.7-17.7%, and routed token cost by 22.5-46.1%, while normal traffic keeps its SLO and energy per request rises by 0.4%.
papers.summary: agent 按步路由模型，简单的步给小模型、难的给大模型，能省钱，但每次换模型都要多付一笔：KV cache 只属于一个模型，换过去的模型手里没有最近的上下文，得先把它补算出来才能吐出第一个 token。在编码 agent 这类长上下文负载上，换模型的那一步最多要慢到平时的 3.2 倍。ShadowPrefill 趁另一个模型的实例服务正常流量时留下的空闲算力，在不影响其延迟目标的前提下提前把当前会话的上下文在那个模型上算一遍。等路由真的换过去，前缀已经在缓存里了。在多组模型搭配上，路由后的 token 成本最多降了 46.1%，每个请求的能耗只多 0.4%。==按步路由的真实成本里，有一块是丢掉的缓存==，用空闲算力提前补算就能把它省回来。

papers.title: Decode Token Parallelism: Memory-Efficient Distributed Attention Parallelism for Scalable LLM Decoding
papers.authors: Susav Shrestha, Brad Settlemyer, Narasimha Reddy
papers.abstract: Serving large language models at high concurrency with long contexts requires KV-cache capacity and attention bandwidth that grow with the decode pool. Existing parallelization strategies trade one against the other: data parallelism replicates model weights, limiting KV capacity; tensor parallelism stops scaling attention at the model's KV-head count and pushes dense collectives across nodes; and decode context parallelism (DCP) recovers capacity by sharding the sequence but adds cross-node aggregation of partial attention results. We observe that during decode, dense layers and attention scale differently: dense layers amortize weight reads across the batch and run efficiently within a single NVLink domain, whereas attention cost grows with every active request's KV cache. We present Decode Token Parallelism (TKNP), a decode-pool architecture that decouples weight placement from attention ownership. TKNP distributes a single model copy across nodes in balanced layer blocks. The active node holding a block executes its projections and MLP for the full batch using intra-node tensor parallelism, while every node computes attention for its own requests against locally resident KV cache. This extends request-local attention across nodes without replicating weights: only current-token activations cross the network, dense all-reduces remain within NVLink, and attention requires no cross-node merging of partial results. Implemented in vLLM and evaluated on Llama 3.1 405B and Nemotron-4 340B on up to 64 H100 GPUs, TKNP improves completion throughput for long-context, high-concurrency workloads by up to 1.7× over DCP and by up to 2.06× over data parallelism at matched GPU count.
papers.summary: 长上下文高并发的 decode 里，稠密层和注意力的开销涨法不同：MLP 和投影只处理新生成的 token，权重读一次就能给整个 batch 用；注意力却要读每个请求越积越多的 KV cache。现有的并行方式各有代价。数据并行要复制权重，挤占了放 KV cache 的显存；张量并行一跨节点，大的 all-reduce 就要走慢网络；按序列切 KV cache 又要跨节点合并每段算出的部分结果。TKNP 把一份模型按层分块摊到多个节点上，每块的 稠密计算在持有它的节点内用张量并行完成，注意力则由每个节点只为自己负责的请求、用本地的 KV cache 来算。跨网络传的只有当前 token 的激活。在 vLLM 上，吞吐比按序列切分最多高 1.7 倍，比数据并行最多高 2.06 倍。==权重放哪里和注意力在哪里算，可以分开决定==。

papers.title: ADIndex: Layer-Adaptive Sparse Attention Indexing via Group-Level Distillation
papers.authors: Jin-Fei Qi, Yiduo Li, Jiang-Xin Shi, Kan Liu, Tao Lan, Hanlin Tang, Yu-Feng Li
papers.abstract: DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) reduces the computational cost of attention through token-level selection. However, its indexer still scores the entire causal prefix for each query, making indexing a dominant source of latency in long-context inference. Notably, the indexer alone can account for more than 50% of total prefill GPU time at long context lengths. To address this bottleneck, we propose ADIndex, an Adaptive and Distillation-driven Indexing method for token-level sparse attention. ADIndex integrates three key components: (i) a layer-wise calibration strategy that adaptively accommodates cross-query retrieval overlap, motivated by our observation of pronounced inter-layer heterogeneity; (ii) a group-level distillation scheme that leverages this heterogeneity to efficiently train adaptive layer-wise group indexers, capturing salient retrieval signals from individual queries; and (iii) a low-latency inference strategy that reduces repeated full-prefix scans through token bank sharing within query groups while retaining query-specific refinement. Experiments on DeepSeek-V3.2 and GLM-5.1 demonstrate that ADIndex preserves near-lossless task performance on LongBench, LongBench v2, and RULER while delivering substantial efficiency gains over standard DSA, including prefill and decoding kernel speedups of up to 6.22x and 3.40x, respectively, at a context length of 256K across the layer-wise reuse configurations, as well as an end-to-end serving speedup of 1.54x at a context length of 128K.
papers.summary: DeepSeek 的稀疏注意力（DSA）让每个 query 只和挑出来的一部分 token 算注意力，但负责挑 token 的索引器仍要给前面所有 token 都打一遍分。上下文很长时，光索引器就能占掉 prefill GPU 时间的一半以上。作者观察到，相邻 query 挑中的 token 大量重合，重合多少还因层而异。ADIndex 让一组相邻 query 共用一次全量扫描：先用一个从原索引器蒸馏出来的小索引器，为整组挑出一个共享的候选 token 池，再由原来的索引器在这个小池子里为每个 query 各自挑最终的 token。每层的组大小和池子大小用离线校准单独定。在两个用 DSA 的大模型上，长上下文任务效果几乎不掉，128K 上下文时端到端服务快了 1.54 倍；上下文短时反而可能变慢。==稀疏注意力省下了算注意力的钱，挑 token 这一步也要省==。

papers.title: Placing LLM Lookup Tables by Per-Layer Prefetch Deadlines
papers.abstract: DeepSeek-V4.1's 203 GB of Engram n-gram tables sit in host DRAM today, taking 190 of the 223 GiB a 4-GPU serving process uses. Row indices depend only on input tokens, so reads can start with each step and overlap earlier layers. V4.1's two Engram layers have windows that differ by 30x (0.3 vs. 9.3 ms). We show that this deadline, together with session reuse and contention on a shared device, decides which tier each table can use and which layers need cache, and we give a model that predicts the resulting slowdown from measured read times. Agent and chat traffic reuse rows within sessions, and static hot sets transfer poorly. We build SlackTier, a table tier for SGLang that issues all lookups at step start. It reads the short-window layer first and splits a small GPU row cache across layers. The path runs inside the decode CUDA graph and is bit-exact with the original gather. Layer 14's table can go to NVMe uncached with no measurable decode cost. With both tables on four NVMe disks, mean time per output token on agent and chat replays rises at most 1.4% over unmodified SGLang, and host memory falls from 212 to 34 GiB. Both tables need no cache when read over RDMA (remote direct memory access) from another node's memory; one copy serves two instances. On a KV-constrained agent workload, using the freed memory as host KV cache at the same memory budget raises median throughput by 36% and cuts median p90 time to first token from 38 to 24 s.
papers.summary: DeepSeek 新模型带了两张按前几个 token 组合去查的大表（Engram 表），大到放不进显存，现在只能放在主机内存里，占掉服务进程的大部分内存。要读哪些行只取决于输入 token，所以每步一开始就能发起读取，和前面的层同时进行。作者发现关键在于读表的那一层前面还剩多少时间。靠后那层前面有十几层垫着，足够从 NVMe 读完；最前面那层几乎没有余量，读不及就得停下来等。SlackTier 据此按层决定表放在哪种存储上、一小块 GPU 缓存分给谁，靠后那层的表直接放 NVMe，缓存留给最前面那层。两张表都放到 NVMe 后，每个输出 token 的时间最多慢 1.4%，主机内存从 212 GiB 降到 34 GiB。==表能放在哪，取决于读它的那层还剩多少时间==。

papers.title: VeRL-Omni v0.3.0: Async Training and Broader Multimodal Post-Training
papers.abstract:
Menu

Theme

Table of Contents

Following our [August v0.2.0 release](https://vllm.ai/blog/2026-08-20-verl-omni-v0-2-0), [VeRL-Omni](https://github.com/verl-project/verl-omni) **v0.3.0** widens what you can train with reinforcement learning in a single, unified stack. This release brings asynchronous execution to more multimodal RL workloads, makes the V1 trainer the default for everyone, and expands post-training coverage across image, video, audio, and multimodal understanding. Building on v0.2.0's rollout batching and reusable model adapters, the focus this time is on making the whole pipeline work _together_: generation, reward evaluation, policy updates, and weight synchronization.

Two end-to-end recipes show what that means in practice: **MiniMax H3 audio-video post-training with DiffusionNFT**, and **MiniCPM-o 4.5 GSPO with colocated-sync or separate-async execution**. Together they demonstrate an important design principle: the right execution mode depends on your workload. Overlapping rollout and training helps only when that overlap pays for the resources assigned to each role — and now you have the tools to measure exactly that.

**Release:** [v0.3.0 release notes](https://github.com/verl-project/verl-omni/releases/tag/v0.3.0) · **Code:** [verl-omni](https://github.com/verl-project/verl-omni) · **Previous release:** [v0.2.0 blog](https://vllm.ai/blog/2026-08-20-verl-omni-v0-2-0)
papers.summary: VeRL-Omni 新版本把多模态强化学习的生成、打分、策略更新和权重同步放进一套流程，并让更多任务可以异步跑：生成和训练放在不同的 GPU 上，中间用一个缓冲区接起来，生成可以跑在训练前面。博客里最有用的是一组对比。在同一台机器上训练 MiniCPM-o 时，回答很短的情况下，把卡拆成生成和训练两组按每条 prompt 算反而慢了约 9%；把回答拉长到 1024 个 token，拆开跑就快了约 6.7%。原因在于只有生成占了大头，把生成和训练重叠起来省下的时间才抵得过拆分的代价。==异步还是同步，要看生成在每一步里占多少时间==。回答短、训练是瓶颈时，生成和训练共用同一组卡仍是默认选择。

papers.title: Validating GPU Platforms with Runtime AI Inventory via the NVIDIA DSX AI Factory
papers.abstract: As teams deploy and scale AI workloads using NVIDIA Dynamo, Kubeflow, or Slurm, tracking what actually runs requires visibility beyond the platform...
papers.summary: GPU 集群的平台配置可以用配方锁住版本、反复复现，但集群上实际跑着哪些模型和推理框架，配方管不到；随时会变的镜像标签还会让两台节点在同一个标签下跑着不同的代码。NVIDIA 的 AI Cluster Runtime 这次把 Google 开源的 k8s-aibom 作为验证过的组件纳入。它监听 Kubernetes 上的工作负载，为每个认出来的 AI 工作负载生成一份 AI 物料清单，记下跑的是哪个模型、由哪个推理框架在服务，每一项还标明是声明的、推断的还是验证过的，以及依据在哪。控制器本身很轻，平均 CPU 只用 2.2 毫核，内存在 28 到 34 MiB 之间。清单记录的是工作负载声明了什么，并不证明它真的调度成功、跑了起来。

papers.title: Manage Kubernetes Clusters for GPU Infrastructure with NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine
papers.abstract: NVIDIA is announcing two open source projects for building and operating managed Kubernetes services on GPU infrastructure—NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine (NVKE) and...
papers.summary: 想把 GPU 算力以托管 Kubernetes 的形式提供给客户的 AI 工厂，要自己做集群开通、租户隔离、升级和故障恢复，还要在不同代的 GPU 和不同版本的 Kubernetes 上把驱动和运行时软件都验证一遍。NVIDIA 开源的两个新项目把这件事拆成两半。NVKR 从固定版本的源码构建节点镜像、容器镜像和软件包，并记下每次构建的全部输入，以后可以原样重建。NVKE 用这些产物，通过 REST API 开通和管理客户集群，每个客户集群有自己的控制面和节点池。客户只需按名字选一个工厂发布好的版本组合，不用直接碰操作系统镜像和启动配置。两个项目可以一起用，也可以单独用，目前都还在公开预览阶段，接口可能变，官方不建议用于生产。
